why_it_fails: Stage: website discovery -> menu resolution. A search lead pointing at the XML sitemap (https://ascendcannabis.com/menu/ch-chicago-ridge-menu/sitemap.xml) was accepted as the "menu" (identity name_locality: the URL/body names Chicago Ridge) and saved as a generic endpoint. XML is not a menu document: dispense.observe() never ran because there is no venueId in it (the real page https://ascendcannabis.com/menu/ch-chicago-ridge-menu/ does carry venueId f623cdcc0ab48711 and Store JSON-LD), and generic.fetch finds no products, giving RENDER_BLANK/partial. Even had it resolved to the Dispense page, that venue is a frozen 2025-11-11 snapshot (see Springfield). The live menu is the Dutchie storefront, reachable only through the Ascend locator, which is not configured.
fix_idea: (1) Ascend chain connector (ascend-store-mapper GeoJSON -> shop_url -> dutchie dispensaryId) as for the other Ascend stores. (2) Shared resolver hardening: reject *.xml / sitemap.xml and other non-HTML documents as menu candidates in site_discovery (menu_document_scope / is_directory_url / canonical_menu_url) so a sitemap can never become an endpoint, and supersede endpoint 510e8821851ae483988e272b. (3) Dispense source-age guard (max product.modified > ~30 days old => stale source catalog) so legacy ascendcannabis.com/menu pages cannot be accepted if search ever surfaces them.
